value.name: Rosa pressures Daniel about notarization
value.description: Rosa calls or messages urgently about whether Daniel can drive Lucia to a notary within two hours because Lucia's signature is now the only one that matters.
evidence: Rosa, who had clearly already done the arithmetic on those PDFs from her end and was going after Daniel about whether he was prepared to drive Lucia to a notary in the next two hours, since Lucia was the only signature that mattered now.

value.name: Asha ignores Rosa's call
value.description: Asha lets Rosa's call go to voicemail while keeping her hand on her father and preparing to speak calmly to the supervisor.
evidence: Asha let it go to voicemail and kept her palm where it was
because the supervisor had picked up and she needed her voice steady

value.name: Asha informs supervisor of discharge and transfer
value.description: Asha tells the supervisor that the proxy is settled, the discharge order should arrive within the hour, and her father will not stay but will be transferred to Bridgepoint before Friday's cutoff.
evidence: she needed her voice steady to say that the proxy was settled, the discharge order was expected within the hour, and no, her father would not be staying.

Asha laid out the three facts in the order she needed them heard: Lucia held the proxy, the discharge order was expected within the hour, and her father would be transferred to Bridgepoint before the Friday cutoff, not held over for a state bed.

value.name: Supervisor concedes the argument
value.description: The supervisor responds with reluctant acknowledgment, signaling that Asha's position has prevailed.
evidence: The supervisor made the small acknowledging sounds people make when they have already lost an argument they had not yet started

value.name: Asha ends call without softening
value.description: Asha thanks the supervisor and hangs up quickly before the conversation can become gentler.
evidence: Asha thanked her and ended the call before any softening could happen.

value.name: Asha calls Lucia about proxy
value.description: Asha phones Lucia, watches her father breathing under the blanket, and opens the conversation by saying Lucia's name and the word proxy.
evidence: Then she dialed Lucia, watching her father's chest rise under the thin blanket
and when Lucia picked up Asha said her name first and the word proxy second, and waited.

value.name: Lucia agrees to be ready quickly
value.description: Lucia does not question the request and says she can be ready in twenty minutes if someone comes for her.
evidence: Lucia did not ask why or how; she said only that she could be ready in twenty minutes if someone came for her

value.name: Asha arranges Lucia's ride
value.description: Asha tells Lucia that a ride is coming and instructs her to bring identification, while withholding whose car will pick her up.
evidence: She told Lucia a ride was coming and to bring her ID, and did not yet say whose car it would be.
